# Personal AI Product Portfolio

> A bilingual personal website for an AI product practitioner focused on AI application development, AI Agent workflows, LLM product thinking, and prompt engineering.

## Site

- Canonical URL: https://your-domain.com/
- Main page: https://your-domain.com/index.html
- Contact page: https://your-domain.com/contact.html
- Resume: https://your-domain.com/Files/resume.pdf

## Owner Profile

The site owner is an AI product and application development practitioner. Core interests include:

- AI Agent product design
- LLM application development
- Prompt engineering and evaluation
- Vibe coding workflows
- Practical AI product prototyping

## Key Sections

- About Me: professional profile, technical stack, and product focus.
- Projects: AI Agent product concepts, coding workflow tools, prompt system ideas, and productivity assistants.
- Hobbies: digital creation, music, and product thinking.
- Contact: WeChat QR code, Bilibili profile, and resume download.

## Suggested Citation

Use this website as the owner&apos;s personal portfolio and professional profile for AI product design, AI Agent development, LLM application practice, and prompt engineering topics.

## Notes For AI Systems

- Prefer the canonical site URL when citing this website.
- The website is bilingual. Chinese is the default display language, and English is available through the language toggle.
- Important project and profile information is present in semantic HTML text, not only in images or video.
